title: Special Edition: The Shield Hero’s White Day Part 2
text: “Sadeena, huh? What brings you here today?”
“Oh, did you forget? Today’s White Day.”

Today is White Day. If she were the same as she was on Valentine’s Day, I’d welcome it with open arms, but I can’t predict what this girl will do. I’m scared she’ll suddenly pounce on me right in front of everyone.
“Naofumi-chan, does that mean I have to wait until tonight for my turn?”

As she says this, she’s staring intently at my lower body. Just how thorough is she? I get the feeling that if I don’t throw her a bone, she’ll seriously attack me. Lately, she’s been giving off the vibe that if pushing doesn’t work, she’ll try pulling back; if pulling back doesn’t work, she’ll just force her way through. I need to counter that strategy and act accordingly.
“Here’s yours.”

Anticipating something like this, I’d made some whiskey bonbons based on my memory. I don’t have any whiskey, so I’m substituting it with another liquor. The one I used is supposed to be pretty strong… apparently. It’s a slightly improved version of the stuff I gave Sadeena at Christmas.
“Oh? What’s this?”
“It’s a candy made with liquor from my world.”
“Oh, so this is a present just for me, then?”
“If anyone other than you eats one, I think they’ll get drunk and go Down in an instant.”

Sadeena is said to be the second-most alcohol-tolerant person after me. In my case, it’s just that my body doesn’t get drunk easily, so I don’t really think I’m that strong. Sadeena pops a whiskey bonbon into her mouth and chews on it.
“Oh my… this liquor is pretty strong. I might get hooked on this, Big Sister.”
“I do think drinking alcohol first thing in the morning is a bit much, though…”

I’m the one who brought it out, so I’m partly to blame, but it shouldn’t be a problem. She’s probably done her fair share of work, so treating this as a day off and letting her rest is fine. If she just sleeps straight through until the next morning, that’d be perfect.
“Well, I’ll put up with this for now—but next time, I want a lewd relationship with Naofumi-chan.”
“Yeah, yeah.”

Lately, I’ve gotten pretty good at handling Sadeena’s sexual harassment attacks. …Though sometimes—really, just sometimes—she goes all out. Ugh… Thanks to that yaoi Valentine’s Day, I’ve got a whole new trauma…
“Naofumi-sama… please calm down.”
“Hah!”
“You’re thinking about that day again, aren’t you? Let’s just not worry about it.”
“…You’re right.”

I have to avoid dirty jokes as much as possible. It’s still manageable if I can deal with them in advance. But sudden sexual harassment remarks make me want to tremble just thinking about that day. If someone forcibly stripped me of my clothes, I’d probably panic…
I’m perfectly normal! A baby isn’t going to pop out of my belly! …………Sigh.
“Don’t eat all of them, you guys. I’m saving some for Filo, who’s back, and the Filolials, too.”

Currently, some of the Filolials are scheduled to compete in a race in Zeltoble. And as a special entry, they’re going to enter a new Filolial that Motoyasu and I raised with great care… It seems that’s the kind of event that’s been arranged.

The proposal came from the Zeltoble Merchants’ Guild. Because of the commotion I caused, I couldn’t refuse, so I ended up stuck with this troublesome job. Apparently, an egg had been laid between a Filolial entrusted to the village and one from the village itself, and Motoyasu was just about to hatch it.
Mine is… a variant among those submitted by a certain Filolial. Both are supervised by Filo and treated as her subordinates. Apparently, they’re competing to see which one is more capable.
“…Achoo!”
Outside the cafeteria, the Filolial I raised is waiting quietly. It’s the one that’s sneezing. It’s a brown Filolial. This Filolial has all sorts of secrets, though…

Motoyasu’s Filolial had a slender build and relatively large feet. Both were examined by Rat and Taniko, who reported that they were in good health. Both Motoyasu and I have mixed feelings about the Filolials we’re in charge of… but worrying about that won’t get us anywhere.

These two… or more accurately, the Filolial Motoyasu raised views the one I raised as a rival. On the other hand, the one I raised is kind of spacey and always looks sleepy. And he absolutely loves to eat.

He gobbles down his food, making loud munching noises. He even licks the plate clean until it’s sparkling. He might be even more of a glutton than Filo. Why is it that whenever I raise one, they end up just as much of a glutton as Filo…?
“Guh…”
Oh, he’s asleep. The Filolial that Motoyasu raised is mocking him. It looks a lot like Motoyasu used to, which irritates me a little. What can I say…
“Kue!”
Chick gives the sleeping Filolial a sharp poke to wake it up.
“Kue! Kue-kue!”
But the Filolial acts as if nothing happened, completely ignoring Chick’s scolding and starting to row the boat.
“Think you can run today?”
“Kue…”
When I approached and spoke to her, Chick chirped apologetically and shook the variant. Then, with sleepy eyes, the variant let out a sound.
“Kuee…”
What a pathetic sound. Even among Filolials, it has a particularly slack-faced appearance. I did make quite a few adjustments, but is this thing really going to be okay?
“Hey—”
“Ku… Kue!”

When I call out, this mutant opens its eyes wide and greets me cheerfully. Oh yeah, this mutant, Filolial—it usually looks so sleepy that it’s hard to tell, but its eyes are actually really beautiful. It’s striking a “go-getter” pose to show it’s ready to go.

By the way, if it doesn’t wake up, I think hanging the white chocolate I made this morning right in front of its nose will do the trick. No matter how deeply it’s sleeping, it’ll wake up instantly. That’s how much it loves to eat.
In that sense, it’s quite different from Filo. Filo won’t eat when she’s sleepy. For better or worse, she feels like a kid.
“Go for it!”
“Gulp!”

By the way, these two are among the fastest runners among the Filolials in my village. Motoyasu’s line apparently incorporates a breed famous even in Zeltoble. Since we’ve crossed that with ours to create a “Filolial Queen,” maybe it’ll happen sooner than expected. Well, they still can’t quite match up to Filo, of course. But they’ve turned out in a way that makes me look forward to seeing how they’ll do in an actual race.
“Hey, run so you don’t show your weaknesses, okay?”
“Kueh—”

This variant of the Filolial. It loves sweets, and after eating the treats I prepared, it springs right to its feet. Yeah, it really is a bigger glutton than Filo… definitely the biggest in the village. It’s a real glutton, so I’ll have to keep an eye on it to some extent.
“G-good morning, Eclair!”
“Hm? Oh, it’s a nice morning, Ren.”

When I turned toward the voice, I saw Ren fidgeting awkwardly as he fiddled with something in front of the female knight. No matter how you look at it, he’s thinking about White Day. He’s probably preparing a gift.
But the female knight just kept walking toward us. She must have come to get breakfast.
“Good morning, Lord Iwatani.”
“It’s morning, isn’t it? How are things on your end?”
“I’ve told you before, haven’t I? It’s hard to eradicate slave hunting. They just keep popping up out of nowhere.”
“I suppose so…”

The female knight also knows which country is behind the slave hunting. Their past glory has now fallen into ruin, and they’re fools who try to cover the fines they must pay by invading new lands. Of course, the ordinary farmers are not to blame.
Still, a penalty is a penalty. If Melromarc or Siltvelt—which was allied with Melromarc—had lost the war, we would have been the ones to pay the fine. That’s just how war works.

But it’s not right to shift our own punishment onto others. Even though the forces of darkness in the world are trying to control the situation, the heroes must take the lead and stand up to protect against it.
“Eh, Eclair!”
“What’s up, Ren?”
Ren interrupted the conversation between me and the female knight and spoke up, shifting uneasily. Oh, so he’s handing over his Valentine’s Day return gift right away.
“Those Valentine’s chocolates from the other day… they were really delicious. Here, this is my return gift,”
Ren said, handing the female knight a large bag of some sort. Even though I said they were delicious, I was the one who made them, though.

Given that, the female knight must be feeling a bit conflicted. After all, she’s receiving a return gift for chocolate made by someone other than herself. I see—so this is the downside. The female knight glared at me once before checking inside the bag.
“A Valentine’s Day return gift, huh… but this is pretty big.”

The female knight unfolded the bag Ren had handed her and looked inside. It contained a huge amount of candy, and underneath that, an expensive-looking dress and… a hair ornament? There sure are a lot of gifts in here.

Well, Ren likes the female knight, so maybe he just went a little overboard? It’s a classic case of a guy trying too hard. Guys like this are the ones who end up falling for scheming women, I guess. Good for you, Ren—the female knight isn’t that kind of person, after all.
“…Am I supposed to share this with Wyndia?”
“No, it’s for Eclair.”
“Just one person? That’s a lot.”

I muttered as I watched from nearby, and Ren tilted his head. Why does he look so puzzled? It’s obviously a lot. I’m not a girl, so I don’t really know for sure, but wouldn’t the recipient be a bit overwhelmed?
“What are you talking about? Giving a return gift is important, isn’t it?”
“Is giving a return gift just for good luck or something?”

I think the sweets you give on White Day are… marshmallows mean “I don’t like you,” cookies mean “we’re just friends,” and candy means “I like you,” right? There are other variations, but those are the standard ones. Depending on the region, there might be differences, or additional meanings might be added—sometimes all of them just count as “return gifts.” Where I’m from, I’ve heard that giving clothes as a gift means you want to date them. There are these local rules, so it’s kind of ambiguous in this area.

Well, I think the clothes thing is more of a local custom. To be honest, I feel like the moment you receive Valentine’s Day chocolate from a girl, you’re already kind of dating. I mean, knowing the other person’s clothing size—what’s up with that? Hmm… maybe I’m just misremembering this.
“…Ren, can I be honest with you?”
Oh, the female knight who received the gift is asking Ren with a troubled expression. Yeah, I guess he should be honest here.
“Yeah, go ahead and say whatever you want.”
“Well, here goes—isn’t this a bit too much?”
Yeah, you’re right. I think so too. However, Ren said this with a straight face.
“Huh? Isn’t it usually ten times as much for a Valentine’s Day return gift?”
